summary: Regression testing for expo-build-properties plugin change in /app/frontend/app.json (adds android.usesCleartextTraffic:true for production APK HTTP streaming). Verified: (1) app.json is valid JSON and plugin block is present with exact expected shape. (2) expo-build-properties@~1.0.10 is already declared in package.json and installed in node_modules. (3) Backend regression: POST /api/auth/login with 1q1q1q1q/1q1q1q1q returns 200 with token and user, GET /api/live/channels returns 224 channels (>200). Full pytest suite 22/22 passing. (4) Frontend regression: /login screen loads via Expo web preview, testIDs render, credentials submit navigates to /profile-select (verified by URL + screenshot showing 'Nexus ¿Quién está viendo?' with the 1q1q1q1q profile). Zero JS page errors and Expo/Metro bundler running fine. The actual production-APK HTTP streaming fix cannot be validated in Expo Go/web preview (as noted by main agent) — it only takes effect after native prebuild+APK rebuild via Publish, which is out-of-scope for this environment.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated 'Unexpected text node: A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' console errors, caused by stray whitespace between JSX tags on same line in login.tsx around line 80 (e.g. `<View style={styles.card} testID="login-card">              <Text ...>`). Pre-existing before this change; does not block navigation but pollutes the console. Reference: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:80
Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' — RN Web deprecation, pre-existing.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — pre-existing.

action_items: None blocking for the current change — the plugin config is correct and no regression detected.

For the user to see HTTP streams working, they must click Publish on Emergent to trigger a fresh Android prebuild + APK build (this will bake usesCleartextTraffic=true into AndroidManifest.xml via expo-build-properties).

Optional cleanup: in /app/frontend/app/login.tsx around line 80, remove the trailing whitespace between `<View ...>` and `<Text ...>` on the same line to eliminate the 'Unexpected text node' console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json plugin block for expo-build-properties uses the correct tuple form ['expo-build-properties', { android: { usesCleartextTraffic: true } }] — this is the officially recommended way and will inject android:usesCleartextTraffic="true" into <application> in AndroidManifest.xml at prebuild time.
AndroidManifest already has INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions — no additional permissions needed for HTTP streaming.
context_for_next_testing_agent: app.json is protected (per Kubernetes rules metro.config/app.json/babel.config are protected) but the main agent modified it intentionally for the native cleartext fix — this is expected. Frontend .env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Test creds: 1q1q1q1q/1q1q1q1q.
